d:
I had been kicking this idea for a little while, a good old Aged Down Shota take of the male characters from my personal favorite Final Fantasy games! The biggest fun part is finding ways to put the boys in either canon outfits they wore as kids, or ones that could work along with sticking to classic outfits for the ladies.

Feel free to follow me on Pixiv to stay up to date with my content!
